subject: Mathematics
curriculum_note: Sequence modelled on common Grade 3-5 fraction progressions (e.g. NCERT / CBSE primary maths, CCSS 3.NF-5.NF). Grade levels are indicative.

skills.name: Understanding fractions
skills.description: A fraction names equal parts of a whole: the denominator is how many equal parts, the numerator is how many we take.

skills.name: Equivalent fractions
skills.description: Multiplying or dividing the numerator and denominator by the same number gives an equal fraction.

skills.name: Simplifying fractions
skills.description: Writing a fraction in lowest terms by dividing top and bottom by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Comparing fractions
skills.description: Deciding which of two fractions is larger, using common denominators or benchmarks.

skills.name: Adding and subtracting with like denominators
skills.description: When denominators match, add or subtract the numerators and keep the denominator.

skills.name: Finding common denominators
skills.description: Rewriting two fractions so they share a denominator (ideally the least common multiple), using equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Adding and subtracting with unlike denominators
skills.description: Convert to a common denominator first, then add or subtract the numerators.

skills.name: Multiplying fractions
skills.description: Multiply numerators together and denominators together, then simplify.

ADD_ACROSS.label: Adds numerators and adds denominators
ADD_ACROSS.explanation: Treats the top and bottom numbers as separate whole numbers (e.g. 1/2 + 1/3 = 2/5) instead of finding a common denominator first.

SUB_ACROSS.label: Subtracts numerators and subtracts denominators
SUB_ACROSS.explanation: Subtracts tops and bottoms separately (e.g. 3/4 - 1/2 = 2/2) instead of converting to a common denominator.

KEEP_ONE_DENOMINATOR.label: Keeps one denominator without converting
KEEP_ONE_DENOMINATOR.explanation: Combines the numerators but keeps one of the original denominators, without rewriting the other fraction (e.g. 1/2 + 1/4 = 2/4).

NUMERATOR_NOT_SCALED.label: Finds a common denominator but doesn't scale the numerators
NUMERATOR_NOT_SCALED.explanation: Multiplies the denominators but leaves the numerators unchanged (e.g. 1/2 + 1/3 = 2/6), so the new fractions are not equivalent to the originals.

NOT_SIMPLIFIED.label: Correct value but not in simplest form
NOT_SIMPLIFIED.explanation: The answer has the right value but was not reduced to lowest terms.

BIGGER_DENOMINATOR_BIGGER.label: Thinks a bigger denominator means a bigger fraction
BIGGER_DENOMINATOR_BIGGER.explanation: Picks the fraction with the larger denominator as larger (e.g. thinks 1/8 > 1/3), not seeing that more parts means smaller parts.

EQUIV_ADD_SAME.label: Adds the same number to top and bottom
EQUIV_ADD_SAME.explanation: Makes an 'equivalent' fraction by adding the same amount to numerator and denominator (e.g. 2/3 = 4/5) instead of multiplying.

MULTIPLY_CROSS_ADD.label: Multiplies numerators but adds denominators
MULTIPLY_CROSS_ADD.explanation: Mixes up the rules for addition and multiplication of fractions.
